source_commands.task3-profile-render.cmd:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'docs/evidence/progress-scaling')
from measure import WORKSPACE, TaskRecorder, environment, read, sha, write
root = WORKSPACE / 'task3-profile-analysis-2'
root.mkdir()
formatter = WORKSPACE / 'pprof'
baseline = read(WORKSPACE / 'baseline-profile-analysis/profile-inputs.json')
if baseline[str(formatter)]['sha256'] != sha(formatter):
    raise ValueError('formatter differs from baseline formatter')
rec = TaskRecorder(root, env=environment(root, Path.home()/'go'), tools=[formatter])
for mode in ('full', 'progress'):
    source = WORKSPACE / ('task3-profile-' + mode)
    manifest = read(source / 'manifest.json')
    result = read(source / 'result.json')
    rows = source / 'rows.jsonl'
    if result['failures'] or result['manifest_sha256'] != sha(source / 'manifest.json') or result['rows_sha256'] != sha(rows):
        raise ValueError('profile manifest is invalid')
    build = manifest['builds']['candidate-' + mode]
    binary = Path(build['binary'])
    sample = source / 'samples' / ('profile-b256-candidate-' + mode)
    row, = map(json.loads, rows.read_text().splitlines())
    if sha(binary) != build['sha256'] or build['sha256'] != row['binary_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('binary differs from profile producer')
    for name, digest in row['profiles'].items():
        if sha(sample/name) != digest:
            raise ValueError('profile differs from captured bytes')
    for path in (binary, sample/'cpu.pprof', sample/'allocs.pprof'):
        rec.bind_tool(path)
    rec.run(mode + '-cpu-flat', [formatter, '-top', '-nodecount=30', binary, sample/'cpu.pprof'])
    rec.run(mode + '-cpu-cumulative', [formatter, '-top', '-nodecount=30', '-cum', binary, sample/'cpu.pprof'])
    rec.run(mode + '-alloc-cumulative', [formatter, '-top', '-nodecount=30', '-alloc_space', '-cum', binary, sample/'allocs.pprof'])
write(root/'profile-inputs.json', {'candidate': rec.snapshot(), 'baseline': baseline})
PY
